frames.name: 01-hero
frames.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium software and automation brand website cinematic scroll keyframe.
Generate ONE standalone landscape artwork, 16:9 aspect ratio, ideally 2048x1152. Never make a collage or contact sheet.
Shared scene: a seamless infinite warm ivory #e9e6de studio environment and ground, with subtle neutral tonal depth, no horizon line. A modular 'software core' sculptural object language, concentric precision-machined liquid-polished chrome rings, graphite inset edges, frosted transparent glass disks and a very small burnt orange energized inner core. Premium conceptual product photography: physically plausible tangible objects, believable metal thickness, crisp resolved geometry, impeccable brushed and polished surfaces, soft large-source ambient illumination, delicate grounding shadows and restrained reflections. Sophisticated luxury engineering, museum-level still life, quiet visual confidence. Ivory dominates the frame, orange is only a tiny controlled accent, no glare clipping.
Constraints: NO text, NO logos, NO letters, NO watermark, NO interface, NO UI, NO people, NO icons, NO cables, no neon cyberpunk, no blue or purple gradients, no cheap science-fiction effects.

Frame-specific composition:
HERO: A single large thick precision-machined chrome toroidal core with a controlled burnt orange light glowing deep inside, suspended just above the ivory ground. The sculptural torus is located centered horizontally at 66% of the frame, visible entirely, shown at a subtle 3/4 angle so the layered glass center and chrome depth are tangible. Large useful negative space on the left 40% for a future headline. The object occupies about 48% of image height, airy luxury still-life composition.
